start.text: Welcome to Phantom World. Your Adventure Begins Here. Phantom World is a vibrant roleplay community where your story matters. From jobs and businesses to heists and friendships, every moment counts.

police_dept.text: Los Santos Police Department. Protect & Serve. Our dedicated police force ensures the safety of all citizens. Join the force or report crimes at our headquarters.

hospital.text: Pillbox Hill Medical Center. Health & Wellness. Our medical center provides comprehensive healthcare services, from emergency treatment to routine check-ups.

city_hall.text: Los Santos City Hall. Civic Services. City Hall is your gateway to government services, job applications, property registration, and legal documentation.

bank.text: Fleeca Bank. Financial Services. Manage your finances with our secure banking system. From daily transactions to major investments, we have you covered.

ammunation.text: Ammunation. Armed & Ready. Licensed firearm dealer offering quality weapons and ammunition for self-defense and sporting purposes.

mechanic.text: Los Santos Customs. Vehicle Excellence. Transform your ride with our comprehensive vehicle modification services. From performance upgrades to visual enhancements.

sandy_shores.text: Sandy Shores Medical Center. Rural Healthcare. Our Sandy Shores location provides comprehensive medical services to the rural communities of Phantom World.

vinewood.text: Vinewood Boulevard. Entertainment District. Experience the glamour and excitement of Vinewood, home to entertainment venues, luxury shopping, and celebrity sightings.

airport.text: Los Santos International Airport. Gateway to the World. LSX connects Phantom World to destinations worldwide. Whether for business or pleasure, your journey starts here.
